results.title: 13 years on, Delhi Police serve notice on Mamata Banerjee in 2013 protest case
N. Ram on his interview with Sonia Gandhi
results.content: In an interview with The Hindu by N. Ram, former Congress president Sonia Gandhi reflects on her upcoming memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love. She discusses the impact of twelve years of BJP-RSS rule on Indian democracy, defends the Congress party’s fight for a level playing field, and shares how her love story with Rajiv Gandhi evolved into a lifelong commitment to India.

results.title: Dhaka wants Hasina extradited under prisoner exchange
results.content: Hasina seeks fresh passport, but Minister Humayun Kabir calls ousted leader a “terrorist” and dismisses request; no response from MEA, sources say denial of passport may complicate matter if India were to extradite Hasina

results.title: The Indian Parliament has entered uncharted territory. Here’s why | The Hindu explains
results.content: India’s Parliament has entered uncharted territory. Eighty-eight days after both houses were adjourned sine die on August 13, the Monsoon Session has still not been formally prorogued or ended. This is now the longest such gap on record.
